method: Each case constructs the real subclass with its native constructor and calls its own place(BlockSource&, BlockPos const&, Random&) directly. Every Random word, every dependency answer and every Feature::_placeBlock attempt are native observations.

source_context.blocksource: BlockSource(Level, Dimension, ChunkSource, true, true) with BlockTickingQueue(Tick(1)); events suppressed
source_context.scene: a 24x24 dirt/stone/water column area, Y 2..25, reset through the original BlockSource::setBlock with flag 0

encoding: block_names interns the names; each scene is base64(zlib(repeated <hhhH> x,y,z,name_index)); a case stores only the cells that changed from its scene.
